name: MEAC Cross Country Championships
headline: MEAC Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: Norfolk State won the men's title with 35 points to Delaware State's 62 and Maryland-Eastern Shore's 87, while N.C. Central freshman Aaron Alukunyang won the individual race in 23:44.8 ahead of Norfolk State's Clinton Kipruto (23:57.3). Howard won the women's title with 23 points to Norfolk State's 65 and Delaware State's 76, and Norfolk State freshman Veronica Jesang won the race in 18:21.8.
